input.description: Expand render with full background and overlay

part.text:
Implemented full rendering logic:

- Clears canvas each frame.
- Draws hazards, then the high‑contrast player.
- Renders HUD with the current score.
- Adds a game‑over overlay when the phase is `"gameover"`.

All updates are placed within the `// === RENDER` section, preserving earlier scaffolding and ensuring the page continues to load without console errors.
